plan.notes: SOURCE: Official Westchester Community College Academic Catalog, 'Program: Computer Science A.S.' (School: Mathematics, Science and Engineering; Academic Dept: Computer Science; HEGIS 5101), Fall 2024 - Summer 2025 Academic Catalog [ARCHIVED CATALOG] (catoid=50). Program Map table transcribed verbatim 2026-09-30 from https://catalog.sunywcc.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=50&poid=4859&returnto=8835&print . Degree name verified as the TRUE 'Computer Science A.S.' via sunywcc.edu (transfer-agreement listing and https://www.sunywcc.edu/academics/majors-programs/computer-science-as/). CATALOG-YEAR CAVEAT: WCC's live catalog is now Fall 2025 - Summer 2026 (verified on catalog.sunywcc.edu homepage 2026-09-30), but its Computer Science A.S. program page could not be retrieved from the sandbox (the sunywcc.edu program page renders its Program Map via JavaScript; direct catalog program-page requests timed out). This file is therefore the 2024-2025 variant, built from the most recent fully retrievable official term-by-term sequence. Course titles, credits, and stated prerequisites were cross-checked against the Fall 2025 - Summer 2026 catalog's official course descriptions (COMSC 101/106/110/116/118/120/201/207/208/210/214/217 all match). If the 2025-2026 program map differs, add it as a year-suffixed file (westchester-as-computer-science-2025-2026.json) -- never overwrite this file. TRANSCRIPTION: the official Program Map's published term totals are 14/16/17/14 = 61 credits, exactly matching the catalog's published degree minimum of 61 credits (General Education 31 + Required Degree Courses 30); no discrepancy. PLACEMENT (not courses, hence absent from external_prereqs): COMSC 101 requires Reading placement >=80 or READ 105, and MATH placement >=41.01 or MATH 93. COMSC 210 additionally lists MATH 161 (or course placement / SAT MATH >=630 / ACT >=28) as math preparation -- the plan's MATH 181 (Semester 2) satisfies this preparation. PREREQ GROUNDING: COMSC 110/217 require COMSC 101 (C or higher); COMSC 201/207 require COMSC 110 (C or higher) -- all per official catalog course descriptions. ENG 102 (prereq ENG 101) and MATH 191 (prereq MATH 181) follow the official program-map term ordering (ENG 101 Sem 1 -> ENG 102 Sem 4; MATH 181 Sem 2 -> MATH 191 Sem 3). ELECTIVES: the two 'Computer Science Elective' choice slots (Semesters 3 and 4) must be two DIFFERENT courses from the catalog list; each elective carries its own catalog prerequisites students must satisfy (e.g. COMSC 208 requires COMSC 207; COMSC 214 requires COMSC 110; COMSC 116 requires COMSC 101; COMSC 120 requires COMSC 101 + one other CS course + ENG 101 + 2.5 GPA; COMSC 118 requires reading/elementary-algebra placement). SCIENCE SEQUENCE: the Part 1 choice determines Part 2 -- both semesters must continue the same track (BIOL 115->117, CHEM 107->111, CHEM 201->205, or PHYSC 121->122).

courses.choice_note: Two-course natural-science sequence; the Part 1 track chosen here determines Part 2 in Semester 2 (BIOL 115->BIOL 117, CHEM 107->CHEM 111, CHEM 201->CHEM 205, or PHYSC 121->PHYSC 122). Catalog recommends PHYSC 121 for best transfer.
